name: ABans Enterprises Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Abans Enterprises Ltd does general trading of agri -commodities, precious metals, trading in securites and derivative contracts[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AEL deals in Commodities, Agri - Commodities, Precious Metals, Shares, Currencies and all kind of Derivatives in exchanges and Spot Market

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

Company has a low return on equity of 7.93% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.28.4 Cr.
